title: The New Right Is More Right than Wrong on Family Policy
author: Brad Wilcox
content:
![The New Right Is More Right than Wrong on Family
Policy](https://www.compactmag.com/content/images/2026/01/edited-photo--2--
2-1.png)

It should have been the perfect day to release a report diagnosing the most
serious maladies facing the American family and prescribing remedies to
restore it to health. After all, the very day the Heritage Foundation released
its [whitepaper](https://www.heritage.org/family/saving-america-by-saving-the-
family?ref=compactmag.com) last week spotlighting the nation's "precipitous
drop in fertility" came news of[
projections](https://www.cbo.gov/publication/61879?ref=compactmag.com) from
the Congressional Budget Office that deaths will exceed births in America in
four years, and the population as a whole will start shrinking in thirty
years. Demographic winter is here.

But because the nation's largest conservative think tank has been mired in
controversy since its president, Kevin Roberts, inexplicably made a video
defending Tucker Carlson in the wake of Carlson's interview with antisemitic
influencer Nick Fuentes, the report landed with a thud. Potentially
sympathetic voices have been muted, while critics from the left have
[denounced](https://bsky.app/profile/barbmcquade.bsky.social/post/3mbw2n2ebn22b?ref=compactmag.com)
it as racist and critics on the classically liberal right have
[attacked](https://www.civitasinstitute.org/research/obamacare-for-american-
orbanists-how-not-to-do-family-policy?ref=compactmag.com) Heritage for
embracing "Orban-style government giveaways."
